scope: Separate Windows Vulkan Forward+ processes at 1280x720 on an isolated desktop. Actual menu and dialogue controls, probe-issued right-click. Timing trials use a 60 FPS cap. Each process's first visit is sampled with a shared OS cache.

historical_and_repeat_diagnostics.scope: Isolated offline Windows desktop, Vulkan Forward+ 1280x720, normal game speed. Only the instrumented copy inserts additional timing calls. CPU attribution applies to new sampled intervals, not the historical peak.
